text:
claire: Pioneer Medical submitted a billing dispute for INV-2026-0999. They say a misconfigured onboarding workflow caused duplicated ingestion and ~2.5x usage for Feb. Asking for a one-time remedial credit and Net45 for two invoices while they remediate.
maya: What's the dollar ask and evidence?
claire: They uploaded usage CSV and infra logs. Requesting $29,400 credit. Current invoice balance $98,000. Sales suggests one-time credit to avoid churn; renewal in 6 weeks.
noah: Infra confirms duplicate job runs from onboarding-script v1.4 causing retries. Snippet: ```service: ingest-runner
period: 2026-02-05..2026-02-20
expected_daily: 2.1M tokens
observed_daily: 5.3M tokens
root_cause: duplicate cron task during rollout```
sam: RevOps: if we grant $29.4k, tag GL 4802_customer_recovery and reason onboarding_duplicate_ingest. Need Finance approval and Legal OK for Net45 exception.
maya: Finance questions: 1) Do we recognize as contra-revenue this quarter? 2) Do we require signed amendment before offering Net45?
claire: Pioneer says they'll sign an amendment within 48 hours if credit is applied now and collections are paused.
legal-bot: Draft amendment: single-paragraph addendum granting Net45 for invoices INV-2026-1000 and INV-2026-1001 only; explicit non-precedent clause; no SLA/pricing changes.
maya: Proposed decision: - Approve one-time credit $29,400 (code CR-ONBOARD-03). - Apply credit to INV-2026-0999 and issue corrected invoice (move original to "adjusted"). - Grant Net45 for next two invoices conditional on countersigned amendment within 72 hrs. - Collections to pause while amendment pending. - Cap: no further retro credits > $50k in 12 months without VP-Finance approval.
oah: I'll prepare RevOps memo and update AR aging once billing posts corrected invoice. Billing: confirm aging bucket change when applied.
billing-bot: INV-2026-0999 link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0999 — balance $98,000. Collections: paused pending adjustment.
maya: Approved $29,400 one-time credit under delegated limits. Approver: Maya (Finance Lead). Conditions: countersigned amendment within 72 hrs; remediation confirmation; escalate any additional credit requests.
claire: I'll send the amendment and the infra logs to Pioneer and update when signed. Thanks all.
